edges.reason: block.timestamp determines the adjusted auction end time, making prolongation miner-influenceable
block.timestamp sets auction start and end times, making auction lifecycle timestamp dependent
_isFinished compares block.timestamp against the stored end time to gate completion
msg.sender is compared against the current highest bidder and used as the payer in bid
msg.sender must equal the NFT owner for onlyHolder in scheduleAuction
msg.sender must equal minter for onlyMinter in scheduleInitialAuction
msg.sender is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner in _authorizeUpgrade
msg.sender is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner in setMinter
msg.sender is restricted to the owner by onlyOwner in setUser
stablecoin state variable is the token transferred in processPayment
serviceCommissionPercent participates in amount * serviceCommissionPercent / 100
agentCommissionPercent participates in serviceCommission * agentCommissionPercent / 100
completeAuction reads beneficiary, highest bid and end time from the auctions mapping
isSubjectToAgentFee flag passed to processPayment during completion
minimumBid reads highestBid and startPrice from the auctions mapping
amount parameter flows into bid validation and state update
artId parameter selects the auction modified in bid
amount parameter is passed directly to the external stablecoin transferFrom
scheduleAuction performs an external NFT transferFrom to escrow the token
bid performs an external ERC20 transferFrom before consistently updating auction state
bid invokes _refundBid to repay the previous highest bidder
bid uses minimumBid for validation and event emission
completeAuction performs an external NFT transferFrom before marking the auction unscheduled
completeAuction calls processPayment, performing external transfers before state cleanup
processPayment performs multiple external stablecoin transfers
_refundBid performs an external stablecoin transfer before state update
Malicious or hook-enabled token can reenter bid during transferFrom
Malicious token can reenter bid through the refund transfer
ERC721 receiver hook can reenter completeAuction during the NFT transfer
Malicious stablecoin can reenter processPayment during transfers
ERC721 receiver hook can reenter scheduleAuction during the escrow transfer
SafeERC20 low-level call can reenter the overridden bid
SafeERC20 low-level call can reenter refundBid
SafeERC20 low-level calls can reenter processPayment

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only used inside bid and merges into the bid function core node
artId is only used inside bid and merges into the bid function core node
artId_ is only used inside scheduleAuction and merges into that function
startPrice_ is only used inside scheduleAuction and merges into that function
beneficiary_ is only used inside scheduleInitialAuction and merges into that function
minter_ is only used inside setMinter and merges into that function
the Auction storage reference a is a bid-local variable
highestBidder is a completeAuction-local cache of the auction winner
highestBid is a completeAuction-local cache of the winning amount
serviceCommission is computed and consumed inside processPayment
sentToTreasury is computed and consumed inside processPayment
agent is resolved and consumed inside processPayment
adjustedTime is computed and consumed inside _adjustAuctionEndTime
minBid is the return value computed inside minimumBid
